item.title: Show HN: BallGuessr – Football player guessing game
item.summary: Hello everyone, I just wanted to share a little side project I worked on recently called BallGuessr. It's more for the football (soccer) fans under us developers. My idea was just to have a guessing game with football players I could play with others. Happy to hear your feedback and ideas. Please note that I just started so there could be a few bugs (oops) :D Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49352391 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
